notablePrerequisites:
Heidar does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least four snow permanents.
description:
Cast Rograkh by paying {0}.
When Rograkh enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm and Dual Nature's first ability triggers.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Dual Nature trigger, creating a token copy of Rograkh.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Rograkh token, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Heidar by paying {2} and tapping it, returning Rograkh to your hand from the battlefield.
Dual Nature's second ability triggers, exiling nothing.
Repeat.
